update.title: PulseVoice update
update.detail: PulseVoice will close for a few seconds and reopen. If you choose Later, it installs the next time PulseVoice restarts.

phoneLinks.title: Phone links
phoneLinks.detail: When you click a phone number link (tel: or sip:) in a browser or another app, PulseVoice opens with the number in the dialer. It never calls by itself. You can change this later from the tray menu or in Settings.

clipboard.title: Nothing to dial
clipboard.body: The clipboard doesn't contain a phone number.
